errors.text_span: The y-axis, labeled "Memory (GB)," also employs a linear scale extending from approximately 150 to 400
errors.evidence: The y-axis starts from 0, not 150. The scale ranges from 0 to 400 GB with tick labels at intervals of 50 GB.

errors.text_span: displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 100
errors.evidence: The x-axis tick labels are at intervals of 200 (0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000), not 100.

errors.text_span: The red line, represented by circular markers and a solid line style, shows a rapid decrease from a value of approximately 380 GB at 0 frames to approximately 230 GB at 400 frames.
errors.evidence: There is no red line in the figure. The pink/salmon line represents VideoLLaMB and appears nearly flat at low memory values (around 20 GB), not decreasing from 380 GB.

errors.text_span: The dark orange line, indicated by square markers and a solid line style, increases from a value of approximately 75 GB at 0 frames to approximately 100 GB at 1000 frames.
errors.evidence: The dark olive/brown line represents VideoLLaMB-R and uses circular markers, not square markers. It starts near ~10 GB and increases to ~40 GB at 1000 frames, not from 75 to 100 GB.

errors.text_span: The teal line, visualized with circular markers and a solid line style, starts at approximately 65 GB at 0 frames and increases to approximately 95 GB at 1000 frames.
errors.evidence: The teal line represents LLaVA-NeXT and starts near ~10-20 GB, increasing to ~145 GB at 1000 frames, not from 65 to 95 GB.

errors.text_span: The light blue line, depicted with circular markers and a solid line style, begins at approximately 40 GB at 0 frames and rises to approximately 80 GB at 1000 frames.
errors.evidence: The green line represents PLLaVA and starts near ~10-20 GB, rising to ~75 GB at 1000 frames. There is no separate light blue line; the description confuses the series.

errors.text_span: the purple line, shown with circular markers and a solid line style, begins near 300 GB at 0 frames and decreases to approximately 350 GB at 400 frames.
errors.evidence: The purple line (VideoLLAVA) uses a dashed line style, starts near ~10-40 GB at low frames, and escalates sharply upward, reaching ~225 GB at ~250 frames and going off the chart. It does not start near 300 GB nor decrease.
The purple line for VideoLLAVA uses a dashed line style, not solid. This visual distinction is missed.
The models are video understanding/language models, not video generation models. The paper title mentions 'Video Understanding'.
The description fails to correctly identify all five models (VideoLLaMB, VideoLLaMB-R, PLLaVA, LLaVA-NeXT, VideoLLAVA) and map them to their correct lines.
